title: Docify API Documentation
description: A lightweight and powerful Express middleware that automatically generates and serves API documentation with zero configuration. Designed to simplify developer workflows and improve API usability.
technicalChallenge: Bundled and served a frontend UI directly from an NPM package
Designed an intuitive and developer-friendly API documentation interface
Ensured seamless integration with existing Express applications
Optimized performance for handling large-scale APIs
Implemented dynamic updates to keep documentation in sync with endpoints

title: Authentication REST API
description: A robust REST API that provides a complete authentication and authorization system using JWT. Built for modern web applications with a focus on security, scalability, and maintainability.
technicalChallenge: Implemented secure JWT-based authentication and authorization flows
Designed scalable and modular architecture for maintainability
Handled password encryption and secure credential storage
Built role-based access control for protected routes
Developed password recovery and session management features
